title: I can't connect to CORP-SECURE Wi-Fi
description: When I try to connect my new device to the corporate Wi-Fi, I enter my username/password but I get 'cannot connect'.

worklogs.description: The device needed PEAP-TLS instead of PEAP-MSCHAPv2; the setting was corrected.
Certificate validation was disabled, so it was enabled. The connection was established.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: I updated your network settings to PEAP-TLS and it's connecting now. You can test it.

resolutionNote: The PEAP-TLS authentication method for WPA2-Enterprise was enabled and server certificate validation was turned on.
